summary: Cessna T210M (N6832B) on a personal flight from Torrance, CA to Aspen lost control in flight and impacted terrain near Cedaredge ~6:10 p.m.; the pilot, the sole occupant, was fatally injured and the airplane was destroyed. The pilot reported his autopilot had disconnected while coordinating an IFR clearance in snow showers, entered a climbing left turn, then descended rapidly; radar and radio contact were lost.
responding_agency: NTSB investigation (CEN14FA064); responding agencies not documented in sources found
notes: SAR-team response not documented in sources found; filed per the aviation-fatality precedent (ids 2307/1031). Date pinned by NTSB factual report + KVNF Nov-20-2013 newscast headline.
